title: Change Log
summary: Changes to Nightcap and this wiki.
body:
November 21, 2026: AA purchase responsiveness

Reduced repeated window refreshes when purchasing AA ranks. Costs, earned ranks and cooldown deadlines are unchanged. Reconnect after server maintenance; no client download is needed. In-game confirmation of the reported freeze remains open. See Multiclass & progression.

November 21: more Classic focus and defensive gear

119 stock item families gain casting focuses, defensive worn effects, or both across all four qualities.

Healing strength remains intact. Existing stats, effects, augments and custom content remain.

See focus choices and defensive drops.

November 20, 2026: Classic focus drops

Added spell haste, healing and mana-preservation effects to 19 stock item families in all four qualities. Existing effects and stats remain. Healing focus no longer grants unintended mana preservation. Healing strength is unchanged. See the item list and spell limits. Reconnect to refresh equipped items.

November 20, 2026: AA availability

Fixed an impossible prerequisite blocking Mastery of the Past for Cleric, Paladin, Ranger, Druid, Shaman and Beastlord builds. All existing AA ranks, prices and effects remain unchanged. Relog to refresh the AA window. See AA availability.

November 20, 2026: fast direct healing

Minor Healing and Light Healing now receive a minimum flat Heal Amount contribution on original casts. Greater Healing, Healing and paladin healing procs retain their existing scaling. Sympathetic healing keeps its existing limit. See fast healing in melee.

November 20: Inventory scrollbars removed

The main Inventory tab no longer has horizontal or vertical scrollbars. The separate Stats tab still scrolls. Fully exit EverQuest and press Play in the launcher. Inventory guide.

November 14: automatic titles and matching suffixes

Titles now unlock automatically when earned, with a chat message and a new-title alert. Every prefix also unlocks a matching suffix through the same achievement. Existing awards gain their matching suffix without another grind. Login and zoning automatically check recorded goals. #titles remains an optional progress list. Title names and requirements.

November 14: earned titles available

The 77 cosmetic titles and #titles are available. Open the Titles window to check existing completion and skill goals. New slayer totals start now. Nagafen earns Flamebreaker; defeating both Nagafen and Vox earns Dragonslayer. Newly earned titles notify you and never replace your selected title.

November 13 · Backstab weapons

Backstab now uses the stronger qualifying weapon in either hand. See how Backstab chooses your weapon.

November 13 · Bow damage

Heroic Dexterity now increases damage from ordinary bow shots. See the bow damage table and Archery Mastery ranks.

November 13 · Classic sympathetic clicks

The Ascended Runed Lava Pendant now grants Sympathetic Strike I. The Ascended Moonstone Ring grants Sympathetic Healing I. Exit EverQuest. Select Play in the Nightcap launcher to get the new spell descriptions. See item sources, eligible spells and bonus amounts.

November 13: wiki layout

The wiki has a simpler layout, shorter guides and direct topic links.

November 13 · Stock equipment ATK

Polished, Exalted and Ascended versions of 135 stock families now use updated worn ATK. See all item values and how the cap works

November 12 · Classic raid boss augments

Classic raid augments drop from 25 named bosses. Classic raid augments

November 12: Inventory combat stats, caps and heroics

Signed client 2026111202 with proxy 0.13.6 adds the combat summary and current/cap/heroic attributes to the main Inventory tab. Instructions

November 12: DoT initial damage removed

Player DoTs no longer deal their separate cast-time damage hit. Timing details

November 12: Imitate Death without cooldown

Removed Imitate Death's ability cooldown and retired its old saved wait. Hotkey instructions and limits

November 12: Quick Buff hotkey creation fixed

Fixed the disabled Make Hotkey button for players who own Quick Buff. Hotkey instructions

November 12: Quick Buff hotkey

Quick Buff replaces passive buff haste with an activated hotkey that immediately casts eligible memorized buffs for 50% maximum mana with no reuse delay. Hotkey instructions

November7: The Last Lantern

The Adventure Journal continues to level 50. Complete eight private memories, choose from five oath paths and earn an eight-piece armor outfit. Start, chapters and rewards

November 7: Advanced Loot client repair

Client 2026110605 repairs automatic opening after closing Filters and visibility after a skin reload, including new loot beyond the first page. Controls and update instructions

Raid and Grind entry now accepts the current expedition augment release.

November6: one Shield Block total

Update2026110604 keeps a single Shield Block row, including equipped augment bonuses, and removes the redundant augment-only breakdown.

November6: Stats font and Hunt label

Update2026110603 matches the added Stats rows to the normal font and row height.

November6: automatic equipped Stats

Signed client0.13.4/update2026110602 adds Shield Block, Hunt contribution, relative Dodge, item focus potential and worn Faerune to Inventory Stats. How to check your stats

November6: zone augments and exotic icons

Augments can drop from any unowned killable NPC in enabled zones, including guards, named enemies, killable merchants and scripted adds. Full list and limits

November 1: zone augments drop three times as often - live

Zone Hunt augments now drop at 1.5% per eligible kill (was 0.5%), about one per 67 kills. How drops work

November 1: solo self-found mode -

New level-1 characters can swear a permanent solo self-found oath at the Ancient Chronicler. How it works

October 30: Plane of Hate density -

Hate modes and landmarks

October 30 — public Classic Cazic-Thule restored

Restored 188 Classic encounter points in open-world Cazic-Thule, which previously had no eligible combat population under Classic.

October 30: Commonlands recall labels corrected

Recall labels corrected (October 30): Client release 2026103001 restores Ancient Attunement’s name, Nightcap Recall’s hotbutton label and the recall description.

October28: Bazaar posting and readable controls

Client update2026102803 accepts valid whole-platinum digits in both text formats, reports unreadable input, and enlarges seller text with light colors.

October 26: Bazaar seller panel and Paladin grips

Sell / My Listings controls

Client update 2026102601 adds the Sell / My Listings tab for posting, cancelling owned listings and collecting offline proceeds. Panel instructions

October 26: Commonlands player bazaar

Persistent player listings, offline seller proceeds and search/purchase routing are installed in public East Commonlands. Market instructions and restrictions

October 24 — High Keep rescue, Ashen Compact and aggro corrections

New High Keep Raid runs now rescue Osargen.

October 24 — Ashen Compact entrance

Its frostbound crossing and return connect to custom Kael. Shadow Knight campaign

October 24 - Multiclass tome learning repaired

Eligible tomes can now be learned through any held class, fixing secondary and third-class Rogue learning. learning combat disciplines

October 24 — Custom content on Features

Features now groups Raid & Grind dungeons, helmet quests, Zone Hunt, epic reforging, class armor, crafting, exploration and custom character systems. Features

Current instructions live in Guides. Guides

October 24, 2026 · A clearer wiki

Features now highlights the major differences from standard EQ.

October 24 · The Hole entrance

— keyless Hole entrance: The Hole Key and lock-picking requirement have been removed from the entrance rock in Paineel at /loc 568,-896,-96.

October 23: two AA per level and level-1 AA controls

The paired update is.

October 23 · The Vigil of the Dawn

October 23: Camil’s Chapterhouse quest, level-50–53 encounters, custom rewards, Ember augment, waypoint and Keeper are deployed. Read the quest guide reward catalog

October 22: production loot finder

The Loot finder supports class, slot, quality, level and zone filters. Item links show enemy sources, locations and drop chances. class and era loot finder

— Hate Keeper in Commonlands: Find the Plane of Hate Keeper in East Commonlands at /loc -1570,-346,3, between Mirielle and Khalure in the travel area.

Build Lab — October 22

The Build Lab compares two saved builds, supported spell benefits, Hunt item stat differences and editable ability priorities. Build Lab

October 22 — Your interactive field guide

The wiki has a new lantern-lit design with four adventure paths, instant quick search, saved guides, light and dark reading modes, and a reading-progress bar. Learn the shortcuts and field notes →

The Classic raid rewards give every dungeon three exclusive designs. Classic raid rewards

October 22 — every Classic dungeon and unique rewards live

Every Classic dungeon coverage adds the same Raid/Grind choices in 21 combat dungeon zones, including Fear, Hate and Sky. Every Classic dungeon coverage

The paired release also repairs stale dungeon item checks behind the reported Keeper error and installs durable Sky key services.

October 22 - quest ingredient fix live for Play

Polished, Exalted and Ascended ingredients can satisfy Normal quest requirements, including Aviak Charm for Crafted Gauntlets. Scope and limits

October 22 — Ascended class-armor quest rewards

Crafted, Lambent, Darkforge, Ivy Etched and Totemic quests now grant 37 Ascended armor rewards. Reward guide

October 22 · Waypoint crystals

Waypoints now have a glowing crystal with the existing a waypoint label.

October 22 — robe waist correction in

Game update 2026102204 repairs the waist binding after the earlier 2026102203 repair failed, covering all seven added Classic robe races and both genders. Read the scope

October 22 — Dungeon Keeper placement

The correction now separates Keepers from overlapping waypoints in Befallen, Unrest, Najena, Permafrost and Nagafen’s Lair. All seven Keeper locations

Level-scaled AA: Earn two AA per level while leveling. AA progression and examples

October 21: slower AA earning and XP boost retirement

The October 21 release used 1,000,000 AA experience per point with 10% passive earning; the October 23 level-scaled update supersedes that earning model.

October 19 · THJ behavior and stock gear

The custom AA, spell focus and stock-derived gear update is. behavior details and open Play limits

October 19: all-class AA update

Live AA Play: All 16 classes have more earned AA options: 75 newly available lines, 111 expanded lines and Druid access to Healing Boon. Read the AA update

Launch repair published: Game update 2026101901 corrects the client catalog mismatch that blocked Play after the previous update.

October 18: item, spell, pet and melee release

Selected Ascended items now use THJ values.

Permanent-pet equipment now has pages. The update also changes pet and melee AAs, Rabid Bear effects and shared stat limits.

October 18 - More ordinary quality loot

Polished, Exalted and Ascended now have 20%, 5% and 1% chances per eligible ordinary equipment/bag drop.

October 18, 2026: built-in item colors

The Reforging Box and zone forging now accept an item's built-in color. Reforging Box zone forging

October 18, 2026: separate ability cooldowns

Activated AA families now have independent cooldowns, including Rampage and Purify Body. Activated AA families now have independent cooldowns generic skill and content-defined groups

October 18, 2026: Classic travel file repair

Signed game update 2026101801 adds automatic missing/corrupt terrain and object archive repair for 17 Classic travel destinations, including West Commonlands, Misty Thicket and Toxxulia.

October 17, 2026: progression, combat and crafting
  • The optional Recommended AA filter provides an early survival, sustain and damage shortlist across held classes.
  • Passive AA is now 10%, preserving full leveling EXP, earned points and 4,000 AA XP per point.
  • Six basic Monk attacks have separate reuse. Cooldown duration repairs address excessive and restarted timers; other shared identities remain under investigation.
  • Normal death costs no EXP or levels; prior losses are not refunded.
  • Stackable items support at least 100, retaining larger limits.
  • The Reforging Box accepts three identical eligible Normal/Base copies for Polished. Higher recipes still cost four.
  • Idle zones can unload without ending their workers and triggering a whole-game restart.
  • Update through launcher Play for the matched client.
October 16, 2026
  • The dungeon guide now lists every required boss and explains boss-stage notices, full-clear credit and Keeper Status when task objectives are blank.
  • Raid and Grind dungeons are deployed with personal boss checklists, shared rewards and exclusive Raid drops.
  • Features now gathers the major departures from Classic.
  • Equipment eligibility recognizes held classes and permits playable races when the class matches; remaining restrictions still apply.
  • Temporary AA buffs keep their timers; ordinary blessings remain lasting.
  • Mira Coinwell provides tunnel banking. Haldra stocks Leather Padding.
  • The wiki’s guides, commands and generated reward pages have been together against current release evidence.
October 13, 2026
  • Passive AA changed from 40% to 20%, preserving full normal XP and 4,000 AA XP per point.
  • All allowed AA ranks open at level 1; points, eligibility and prerequisite ranks remain.
  • Stacked tradeskill ingredients and Craft All are deployed.
  • The tunnel workshop layout is more spacious; the Unrest waypoint moved beside its entrance Keeper.
  • Supported divine summoned-hammer families have zero resale value.
  • The reported multiclass training/offhand issue and merchant Sell All button issue were confirmed resolved.
October 11–12, 2026
  • Reusable four-copy upgrades are available from Artisan Veyra; higher #zoneforge steps now use four copies.
  • LORE restrictions are disabled. Food and drink requirements were removed.
  • Early scribing allows eligible scrolls into the spellbook before their casting level.
  • Sell All protects food, drink, reagents and casting focus items.
  • The launcher uses personal access codes and shows patch summaries.
  • Waypoint portals and floating-eye Instance Keepers received visual corrections. The reported pet-summon crash was confirmed resolved.
October 9, 2026
  • 48 Classic reward zones, 384 reward variants, type-22 augments and zone forging launched.
  • Passive AA increased to 40% at that time; the October 13 reduction above supersedes that rate.
  • Always Loot / Never Loot controls, effective Spell Damage on Throw Stone, and kept spell gems after normal death were added.

Custom AA behavior

  • Warlord’s Fury: +100% physical skill damage for up to 12 seconds, 60-second reuse.
  • Gut Punch: initial damage and +50% physical damage taken for up to 12 seconds. Press the Attack lowers AC; Grappling Strike lowers evasion.
  • Act of Valor: spends 50% of maximum mana once and heals nearby group members for 2 HP per mana spent.
  • Harvest: activate to restore 40% maximum mana.
  • Mana Burn/Blast/Blaze/Volatile Mana Blaze: spend 10/20/30/40% maximum mana; keep 4 damage per mana as a tuning choice. All reach 15-minute reuse with full Hastened Manaburn. Target immunity rejects the cast without mana or cooldown loss.
  • Silent Casting: all casting classes, one-hour duration, 60-second reuse, suspendable timer. Subtlety and obsolete haste/duration modifiers refund purchased ranks.
  • Dimensional Shielding: separate Wizard AA protecting casting from hits, movement and hostile interrupt effects. Stuns and voluntary cancellation still interrupt. Its 120-second duration and 30-minute reuse are kept-value tuning choices.
  • Pyromancy/Cryomancy: 35% proc chance, initial damage plus DoT, opposite-element resistance reduction and compatibility with other buffs. Existing level/mana/trigger restrictions remain.
